text:
alex: FYI — after the eu-west fractional-consolidation job we started seeing short p99 spikes on inference lanes around 21:40 UTC. GPU utilization fine, networking tails only.
maria: noticed TCP retransmits and kernel tx_queue depth jitter on a subset of ToRs.
kevin: any single noisy tenant?
alex: not one — looks like consolidation shuffled multiple hot tenants behind the same ToR SNAT pair (toR-12). p95 +40ms p99 +120ms on affected racks.
sara: infra-bot shows policy fractional-consolidate-v2 completed at 21:30 (rc-20260320-19). infra-bot: affected-tenants=[t-12,t-42,t-77,t-99,t-108,t-204], current-snats: toR-12=[snat-a,snat-b], toR-13=[snat-c].
ops-lead: hypothesis: packing changed egress adjacency -> ToR head-of-line + switch burst coalescing -> microbursty tails.
maria: short-term mitigation — split SNAT set across two ToRs for the hot tenants (soft split) to smooth microbursts.
kevin: propose canary: 15% of flows for selector label=hot-infer use backup SNAT on toR-13. Command: ```bash
redwoodctl network redirect-egress --region eu-west --selector 'label=hot-infer' --percent 15 --from-snat toR-12 --to-snat toR-13 --reason "egress-stitch-canary"
```
kevin: will also enable tcp_queue probes per-snat and a per-snat p99 tail metric, plus BGP delta probe.
alex: prefer canary to full rollback.
sara: I'll run smoke harness after 15% goes live and monitor SLA deltas.
maria: mute high-frequency paging for p99 alerts for 10m to avoid noise. I'll also watch egress-cost delta.
infra-bot: redirect-egress initiated (id=rj-20260320-nw1), status=rolling.
kevin: canary live @21:55. 5m burn.
sara: smoke after 10m: no SLA breach, p99 on affected racks dropped ~50%.
maria: signal looks good, expand to 50% then 100% if stable.
kevin: expanding to 50% now. toR-13 tcp_queue rose slightly but within threshold.
ops-lead: long-term: allocator should consider egress-affinity as a soft constraint. propose placement.score.weight.egress_affinity=0.1 as experiment.
alex: agree. follow-ups: kevin -> instrument per-snat tails & run placement experiment; alex -> tenant->ToR correlation and historical pack delta; maria -> cost check + alert tuning; sara -> update infra/egress-mitigation runbook and smoke harness. reconvene in 24h or earlier if signals reappear. :thumbsup:
